article.excerpt: “Canada’s youngest province and Britain’s oldest colony” is what some of them say. article.title: El Salvador observations
article.excerpt: The best meal was whipped yucca with chicharrón and vinegar, sold next to Tazumal . The ubiquity of corn products means the country has less culinary variety than any of the other eighty lands I have visited. There is a Taiwanese restaurant in San Salvador, however.
